notice: Draft for review. Not frozen, not hash-locked, and not a basis for any claim. Every field may change before freezing. No held-out task, hidden test, or grader configuration has been opened while drafting it.
question: With the controller held fixed, does a policy-learning arm change trusted multi-step task success relative to the base policy on the same tasks and seeds, and how much of any outcome is attributable to the controller rather than the policy?

harness.store: src/vare/trajectory_store.py (append-only hash-chained events; one store per (arm, controller); audit before every metric)
harness.tool_surface: scripts/run_local_agent.py helpers (list_files, read_file, search_text, apply_patch, replace_text, run_public_tests, check_syntax, finish)
harness.resume: fresh workspace per claim; committed applied edits replayed and hash-checked; uncommitted work discarded; enrollment metadata (controller digest, policy checkpoint, task digest) must match on resume

base.policy: frozen base model (identity as in protocols/coding_policy_learning_mlx_4b_v1.json model block)

rft.condition: only if that adapter exists with its own committed evidence

grpo.condition: only if a GRPO adapter exists under its own frozen protocol; otherwise the arm is omitted, not substituted

verifier_aware.condition: include only with a written justification and a separate pre-registered comparison; never pooled with the arms above

controller.digest_rule: ControllerConfig.sha256() is recorded at enrollment; policy comparisons are refused across controller digests
open_items: confirm reveal_target=true is the intended primary setting; a reveal_target=false preset would measure navigation without a hint

tasks.smoke: configs/learning_pipeline_v1/train.manifest.jsonl only (Train split; harness refuses non-Train rows and test-file read scope)
tasks.held_out: TO BE DEFINED: a repository-disjoint set selected and hash-frozen before any held-out access. It is not opened, listed, or sampled while this document is a draft.
never: held-out tasks, hidden tests, or grader configurations before freezing
tasks from repositories used for training any arm

budgets.tasks: TBD after a Train smoke measures per-episode wall-clock on the target machine
budgets.per_episode: controller budgets above; episodes that exhaust a budget are recorded with their stop reason and count as not successful

grading.primary_grader: isolated trusted repository grader (schema learning_pipeline_repo_env_grade_v2, isolation mode required, attested, hmac_frames_v1 verdict channel)
grading.fail_closed: ungraded, untrusted, legacy-native, errored, or unchanged-source episodes are never successes and stay in the denominator
grading.public_tests: a tool signal only; never an outcome

metrics.primary: final_success: trusted grader pass, per (task, seed), denominator = all enrolled episodes
secondary: navigation.correct (target file read before first applied edit; edits only in target files)
recovery.rate (failed action later followed by a successful action of the same category)

statistics.unit: paired (task, seed) episodes between two arms under the same controller digest
statistics.primary_test: repository-clustered paired bootstrap of the success-rate difference (vare.eval_stats.paired_bootstrap_interval on per-repository mean differences; 95%)
statistics.supporting: exact McNemar on task-level majority outcomes (vare.eval_stats.mcnemar_exact)
statistics.multiplicity: TBD; proposal: rft-vs-base primary, others exploratory
statistics.minimum_reporting: all arms, all episodes, including budget-exhausted and ungraded ones

ablations.policy: base vs each learned arm, controller fixed at the primary preset
ablations.controller: same arm under full vs minimal; reported as controller attribution, never as a policy effect

will_not_claim: any result from the synthetic smoke fixture or the scripted stub policy
any capability change from Train-split runs
a policy effect from a comparison that crosses controller digests
generalization beyond the frozen held-out repositories
success from public tests, model self-report, or an ungraded episode
before_freezing: fix held-out task set and hash it
fix seeds, task count, and multiplicity rule
record source digests of scripts/long_horizon_eval.py, scripts/run_local_agent.py, src/vare/trajectory_store.py, and the grader runner
run a Train smoke on the target machine and record budget feasibility
